title: Roof Replacement in Boring, OR
summary: In October 2024, French Roofing replaced the roof on a home in Boring, OR. The crew tore off all layers of the old brown shingles down to the wood deck, laid new synthetic underlayment, and installed new CertainTeed Landmark shingles with new valley metal, flashings, attic vents and ridge cap.
scope: Tore off all layers of the old roofing down to the wood deck
Installed new synthetic underlayment, painted drip edge and gable flashing, and self-sealing starter shingles
Installed new CertainTeed Landmark shingles with 24 inch valley metal
New front wall and sidewall flashing, plus new double-seal flashings on the vent pipes
Replaced the attic vents and capped the ridges with standard ridge cap
body: This is a big, many-sided roof out in the country, with long valleys and a lot of ridge line. The photos follow it from the old brown shingles, through the tear-off and new underlayment, to the finished roof.

faqs.question: Did the old roof come off on this Boring job?
faqs.answer: Yes. All layers of the old roofing came off down to the wood deck before the new underlayment and shingles went on.
